Synthetic: true
ID: sample-010
Title: Synthetic document handoff
Date: 2026-11-13
Type: Note
Collection: Studio
Author: Alex Morgan

The first sample set contains ten fictional text documents dated November 1 through November 13, 2026. Each document has a stable ID, title, date, type, collection, and author. Blank lines separate the original body passages.

Alex Morgan prepared the set for the Studio project. Sam Chen reviewed collection labels and confirmed the next prototype review for November 20 at 10:30 at Cedar Library. That future review remains upcoming as of this note.

The set includes repeated people, repeated places, a changed appointment, a proposed trip without a date, and a word that can refer to different things. No real mailbox, private document, or external source was used. These documents are ready for a future ingestion API; this handoff does not claim that the API exists.
